GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions, answered.

Is the contract a trading account or token?

No. It purchases time-limited access to the exact research prediction batch recorded in the holding. It does not mint a token, hold exchange funds, place orders, promise returns, or transfer ownership of subscriber capital.

What am I paying for?

The USD payment is the research-list access fee. The separately displayed USD bot-capital estimate is calculated from peak overlapping positions and the production model’s per-position budget; that capital remains in the subscriber’s own exchange account and is not paid to DLI.

Why can issuance be held?

A contract cannot be sold unless production has a fresh scope with at least one prediction that passes every chronological, confidence, error, spread, stability, and data-quality gate, plus a fresh USD conversion.

How are my details stored?

Account and purchased-list records are encrypted. Passwords are salted hashes. Card details are handled by Razorpay and are not stored by this portal.

When does access become active?

After Razorpay confirms a captured payment with a valid server signature, the exact batch is saved in My Holdings and becomes downloadable for the purchased access period.

Research access
